notes.title: Birthday sale again!!
notes.content:
28/04 is the birthday of me, Takashi Yukihara. I wouldn't like to be celebrated it, but I felt like that I should do something nice, so I decided to have a one-day sale same as last year's one. The discount will be available from 0-24am JST.


Living in Spring: 40% off
Living in Spring - Full Size Event CG for digital wallpaper: 40% off
Main Theme and Ending Music from “Living in Spring”: 40% off
"Living in Spring" with broadcasting approval: 10% off (bundle, constantly)

Discount rate formula: (1.0-(1.0-0.4)×(1.0-0.1))×100=46%

This is the first 46% discount by now, and will be once a year with such as discount rate.
I hope you will pick them up.
